body:
> ### Steps to reproduce
>   * Make a scene
>   * Add a SubViewport node (doesn't matter if under a SubViewportContainer, but best for visual cue)
>   * Add 2 Sprite2D
>   * Make one of them a child of the other
>   * Set clipping on the parent Sprite2D to Clip only
>   * Put it under the SubViewport and you will see the bug

Can't reproduce. Tested in v4.4.stable.official [4c311cbee] (version used in the shown screenshot), works fine for me with any renderer picked (Compatibility/Mobile/Forward+).

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/742656b7-3f19-402a-a041-987f27296dbd)

> ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)
> 
> As mentioned above/ shown in screenshots.

So please provide MRP to ensure it's not about different project setup.

> ### System information
> 
> Windows 10 - Godot 4.4 - OpenGL

A more detailed info might be useful in case it's an issue about some specific GPU etc. You can copy such info from within the editor:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/26df04377e897595495980309535064e1bacdf53/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml?plain=1#L38

> Line 38 in [26df043](/godotengine/godot/commit/26df04377e897595495980309535064e1bacdf53)
>          - **Starting from Godot 4.1, you can copy this information to your clipboard by using *Help > Copy System Info* at the top of the editor window.**

I was busy when I initially made the issue, here is the full system info : 
- Godot v4.4.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7260) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12700F (20 threads)

 > So please provide MRP to ensure it's not about different project setup.

This was tested on more than one project. The project seen in the screenshot is massive and it would be hard to send as a zip. The repository of the project (PNGTuber-Remix) is available on my profile. The scene that this was tested on was main.tscn

I hope this helps, because I am not too sure if this is a my pc issue or what specifically..

> This was tested on more than one project. The project seen in the screenshot is massive and it would be hard to send as a zip. The repository of the project (PNGTuber-Remix) is available on my profile. The scene that this was tested on was main.tscn

So I've checked it out, the missing piece of information was that you've enabled `transparent_bg` for your SubViewport. With it I can reproduce it indeed. All renderers, latest `master` (v4.5.dev.custom_build [26df04377]).

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/052c3b9d-14ab-470e-a396-fdec470bd905)|![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/495f3892-7919-4e36-b7e6-86bda8222fed)
-|-

After [searching for `clip`+`transparent`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aopen%20clip%20transparent), seems it's a longstanding issue already reported in #75616/#94208. Both seem to be the same issue, just one is reported for the project root viewport/window and the other for a subviewport.

So I'm closing this as a duplicate of #94208.

(and it's of course not an issue about your pc)
